title: BIG DEMO UPDATE - Roguelite Tower Defense - Get Outta My Gut - Made with Claude
author: Life-Heron-6533
selftext:
**Demo Page:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5096200/Get\_Outta\_My\_Gut\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5096200/Get_Outta_My_Gut_Demo/)

New Features:

* **Glossary -->** You can now discover and study Towers, Enemys, Effects in the menu
* **Performance** **-->** We added a new Performance Setting, which allows weaker Hardware to run the game
* **Disable Combat Text -->** You can now Disable Combat Text if you don't like it in the settings
* **Controls Mapping** **-->** You can now Remapp the Controls in the Settings
* **Pause the fight -->** Its now possible to pause the fight with Space Bar in running Wave or start the wave in building mode woth space bar
* **Controller Support -->** You can now play the game with Controller
* **Steamdeck Support (Still in testing) -->** We added Support for the Steam Deck, but we still need to test it
* **Notifications / Intorductions -->** Each Level now pops notifications when some new mehcanic important mechanic gets introduced
* **Quit Button -->** I don't want to flex with that but we now have a quit button, which i forget adding in the first version ʕノ•ᴥ•ʔノ ︵ ┻━┻

  
Imporvements:

* **Translations -->** Improved our english wording and all translations
* **Game Speed Numbers -->** We cut game speed number to x1,x2,x3 (is like x9) instead of x1,x2,x3,x9
* **New Visual Effects -->** New visual effects got introduced for the enemies like stun, mucus, healing, etc.

  
Fixed Bugs:

* Laser Refractions was able to refract through walls
